calculators.title_en: Switzerland Gross to Net Salary & Social Deductions Calculator
calculators.description_native: Berechnen Sie Ihren Nettolohn in der Schweiz unter Berücksichtigung von AHV/IV/EO (5,3%), ALV (1,1%), BVG (2. Säule Pensionskasse), NBU, KTG und kantonaler Quellensteuer oder Einkommenssteuer. / Calculez le salaire net en Suisse avec déductions AVS/AI/APG, LPP et impôt à la source.

inputs.name: number_of_children
inputs.label_native: Anzahl Kinder (Kinderzulagen) / Nombre d'enfants à charge

inputs.name: residence_permit
inputs.label_native: Aufenthaltsstatus (Quellensteuer vs. Ordentlich) / Statut de résidence
options: B-Bewilligung / L-Bewilligung (Quellensteuerpflichtig / Impôt à la source)

calculators.formula_explanation:
1. 1st Pillar AHV/IV/EO (AVS/AI/APG): 5.3% employee contribution on total gross salary (unlimited). Employer matches 5.3%.
2. Unemployment Insurance ALV/AC: 1.1% on earnings up to CHF 148,200/year (0% above CHF 148,200 following the abolition of ALV2 solidarity contribution in 2023). Employer matches 1.1%.
3. 2nd Pillar Occupational Pension BVG/LPP: Applied to Coordination Salary (Koordinationslohn = Gross Salary - CHF 25,725 coordination deduction; bounded between CHF 3,675 min and CHF 62,475 max). Retirement credit savings rates shared 50/50 employer/employee based on age brackets: Age 25-34 (7% total / 3.5% employee), Age 35-44 (10% total / 5.0% employee), Age 45-54 (15% total / 7.5% employee), Age 55-65 (18% total / 9.0% employee), plus risk insurance (~0.5% employee).
4. Non-Occupational Accident Insurance NBU/AAN: ~0.8%-1.5% employee contribution depending on company risk classification.
5. Daily Sickness Allowance KTG/APG: ~0.5% employee contribution.
6. Quellensteuer / Income Tax: For B/L permit holders, cantonal Quellensteuer withholding tariffs (Tarif A single, B married single-earner, C married double-earner, H single parent) are applied directly to monthly gross pay. For C permit/citizens, net income after social deductions is subject to cantonal and federal tax scale.
7. Child Allowance (Familienzulagen): +CHF 200 to CHF 300/month per child depending on canton (e.g. GE CHF 300, ZH CHF 200).
8. Net Take-Home Pay = Gross Salary - AHV/IV/EO - ALV - BVG - NBU - KTG - Quellensteuer + Child Allowance.

calculators.title_en: Switzerland Pillar 3a Tax Savings & Retirement Optimization Calculator
calculators.description_native: Berechnen Sie Ihre exakte Steuerersparnis durch Einzahlungen in die Säule 3a in der Schweiz basierend auf Ihrem Wohnkanton, Einkommen und Zivilstand. / Calculez vos économies d'impôts avec le 3ème pilier A.

inputs.name: employment_type
options: Angestellter mit Pensionskasse (BVG) / Salarié affilié LPP
Selbstständig ohne Pensionskasse (BVG) / Indépendant non affilié LPP

inputs.name: years_to_retirement
inputs.label_native: Jahre bis zur Pensionierung / Années jusqu'à la retraite

calculators.formula_explanation:
1. Maximum Statutory Contribution Limits (2025/2026): Employees with BVG pension fund can deduct up to CHF 7,258/year. Self-employed without BVG pension fund can deduct up to 20% of net earned income, capped at CHF 36,288/year.
2. Marginal Tax Rate Determination: Combined Marginal Tax Rate = Federal Direct Tax (Direkte Bundessteuer) marginal rate + Cantonal Tax (Staatssteuer) marginal rate × Cantonal Tax Multiplier (Steuerfuss) + Municipal Tax (Gemeindesteuer). Marginal tax rates range from ~18% in low-tax cantons (Zug, Schwyz) to ~42% in high-tax cantons (Geneva, Vaud, Basel-Stadt).
3. Immediate Annual Tax Saving = Min(Planned Contribution, Max Statutory Limit) × Combined Marginal Tax Rate.
4. Wealth & Capital Tax Exemption: Pillar 3a assets are completely exempt from Swiss annual wealth tax (Vermögenssteuer) and income tax on dividends/interest during the accumulation phase.
5. Withdrawal Taxation (Kapitalbezugssteuer): Payout at retirement (ages 60-65) is taxed separately from ordinary income at a reduced cantonal rate (~2% to 10%). Staggering withdrawals across up to 5 separate 3a accounts in different years minimizes progressive tax bracket escalation.

calculators.title_en: Switzerland Sole Proprietorship vs. GmbH Tax & Social Security Simulator
calculators.description_native: Vergleichen Sie Nettogewinn, AHV-Beiträge, Einkommens- und Gewinnsteuern sowie Haftungsrisiken zwischen Einzelfirma und GmbH in der Schweiz. / Comparez la raison individuelle et la Sàrl en Suisse.

inputs.name: annual_revenue
inputs.label_native: Jahresumsatz (€ / CHF excl. MWST) / Chiffre d'affaires annuel (CHF HTVA)

inputs.name: business_expenses
inputs.label_native: Geschäftsaufwand (€ / CHF excl. MWST) / Charges professionnelles (CHF HTVA)

inputs.name: canton_seat
inputs.label_native: Kanton des Firmensitzes / Canton du siège social

inputs.name: dividend_payout_ratio
inputs.label_native: GmbH Gewinnausschüttung als Dividende (%) / Distribution de dividendes (%)

calculators.formula_explanation:
1. Sole Proprietorship (Einzelfirma / Raison individuelle):
   - Net Profit = Revenue - Expenses.
   - Self-Employed AHV/IV/EO Contribution: Sliding scale from 5.371% (profit < CHF 9,800) up to 10.0% (profit >= CHF 58,800) plus SVA administration fee (~1.5%-5.0% of AHV amount).
   - Personal Income Tax: Net Profit minus AHV contributions is added to personal income and taxed under progressive cantonal and federal personal tax rates.
   - Unlimited personal liability for all business debts.
2. GmbH (Sàrl / SAGL):
   - Minimum Share Capital required: CHF 20,000.
   - Taxable Corporate Profit = Revenue - Expenses - Director Salary - Employer AHV/ALV/BVG Social Contributions.
   - Corporate Income Tax (Gewinnsteuer): Combined Cantonal + Federal rate on net corporate profit ranges from ~11.8% (Zug, Nidwalden) to ~19.7% (Zurich) and ~14.0% (Geneva).
   - Privileged Dividend Taxation (Teilbesteuerung von Dividenden): Distributed corporate profit paid as dividend to qualified shareholders (>=10% stake) receives a 30% federal tax relief (taxed at 70%) and 30%-50% cantonal tax relief.
   - Director Personal Tax: Director salary is taxed as standard employee income + employee social security. Remaining net dividends taxed under privileged dividend rate.
   - Limited liability restricted to GmbH share capital.
3. Financial Crossover: GmbH typically provides net tax and risk advantages above CHF 80,000 to CHF 120,000 net profit per year.

calculators.description_native: Berechnen Sie Handänderungssteuern, Notariats- und Grundbuchkosten sowie die FINMA-Hypothekar-Tragbarkeit für den Immobilienkauf in allen Schweizer Kantonen. / Calculez les frais de notaire, impôts de mutation et la soutenabilité hypothécaire.

inputs.name: purchase_price
inputs.label_native: Kaufpreis der Immobilie (CHF) / Prix d'achat du bien (CHF)

inputs.name: canton
inputs.label_native: Kanton der Immobilie / Canton du bien

inputs.name: gross_household_income
inputs.label_native: Brutto-Jahreseinkommen Haushalt (CHF) / Revenu brut annuel du ménage (CHF)

calculators.formula_explanation:
1. FINMA Mortgage Affordability Rules (Tragbarkeitsprüfung):
   - Minimum Down Payment Required: 20% of purchase price (minimum 10% must be hard equity outside 2nd pillar pension withdrawals).
   - Maximum Loan-to-Value (LTV): 80% (First Mortgage up to 66.7%, Second Mortgage 66.7% to 80%).
   - Imputed Stress-Test Interest Rate: 5.0% per annum on total mortgage amount (Purchase Price - Down Payment).
   - Property Maintenance & Operating Costs: Fixed at 1.0% per annum of purchase price.
   - Amortisation: Second Mortgage (portion above 66.7% LTV) must be amortised linearly over 15 years (or by age 65).
   - FINMA Affordability Test: Total Annual Carrying Cost = Imputed Interest (5%) + Maintenance (1%) + Annual Amortisation. Must NOT exceed 33% of Gross Annual Household Income.
2. Cantonal Property Transfer Tax (Handänderungssteuer / Impôt sur les mutations):
   - 0% (Abolished): ZH, SZ, GL, ZG, AG, SH, UR, TI (primary home).
   - Bern (BE): 2.0% (exempt on first CHF 500,000 for primary residence).
   - Vaud (VD): 2.2%.
   - Geneva (GE): 3.0% (Centime additionnel exemptions apply for primary Centenaire home purchases).
   - Valais (VS): 1.0% - 1.5%.
   - Neuchâtel (NE): 3.3%.
   - Fribourg (FR) & Lucerne (LU): 1.5%.
3. Notary & Land Registry Fees (Notariats- und Grundbuchkosten): Official cantonal tariff scale: Notary fees (~0.1%-0.5% of price) + Land Registry entry (~0.1%-0.3%) + Mortgage Register Note creation fee (Schuldbrieferrichtung ~0.1%-0.3% of mortgage value).
4. Total Purchase Closing Cost = Purchase Price + Handänderungssteuer + Notary & Land Register Fees + Mortgage Note Fees.

inputs.name: taxable_property_value
inputs.label_native: Steuerwert der Immobilie (CHF) / Valeur fiscale du bien (CHF)

inputs.name: canton
inputs.label_native: Kanton der Immobilie / Canton du bien

inputs.name: property_age_years
inputs.label_native: Alter der Immobilie (Jahre) / Âge du bien (années)

inputs.name: taxable_income_before_property
inputs.label_native: Steuerbares Einkommen vor Liegenschaft (CHF) / Revenu imposable hors bien (CHF)

calculators.formula_explanation:
1. Imputed Rental Value (Eigenmietwert / Valeur locative):
   - Under Swiss tax law, home owners occupying their own property must add 60% to 70% of theoretical market rental value to taxable income.
   - Cantonal formula: Estimated as ~60%-70% of market rent or 3.5%-4.5% of official taxable cadastral value (Steuerwert).
2. Allowable Tax Deductions:
   - 100% of actual Mortgage Interest Paid (Hypothekarzinsen) up to legal cap (taxable income + CHF 50,000).
   - Property Maintenance Deduction (Unterhaltsabzug): Taxpayer chooses annually between:
     a) Flat-rate deduction (Pauschalabzug): 10% of Eigenmietwert for properties <= 10 years old; 20% of Eigenmietwert for properties > 10 years old.
     b) Actual Maintenance Costs (Tatsächliche Kosten): 100% of documented value-preserving repairs, energy-saving investments, and building maintenance expenses.
3. Net Change in Taxable Base = Eigenmietwert - Mortgage Interest Paid - Max(Flat-Rate Maintenance, Actual Maintenance Costs).
4. Net Income Tax Impact = Net Change in Taxable Base × Cantonal & Federal Combined Marginal Tax Rate. (If deductions exceed Eigenmietwert, owner gains net tax reduction; if Eigenmietwert exceeds deductions, owner pays net additional tax).
